Padma Textile Mills Ltd
QUOTATION
Quotation no. QT-2026-901 Date 2026-10-21
To Aamar Garments Ltd (fictional) Reference PR-2026-114
Item Description Qty Unit Unit price (BDT) Amount (BDT)
A Cotton twill fabric, 280 gsm 12,000 metre 472.00 5,664,000.00
Subtotal 5,664,000.00
VAT 15% 849,600.00
Total 6,513,600.00
Supplier TIN: 101458013391 BIN: 000170141-0101
TERMS AND CONDITIONS
1. Payment. 10% advance payable with the purchase order. Balance payable within 45 days after delivery and
acceptance of goods.
2. Delivery. Delivery within 24 days of receiving the purchase order.
3. Delay. Late delivery penalty: 1% of order value for each full week of delay.
4. Validity. This quotation is valid for 45 days from the date above.
5. Quality. Goods are supplied as per the buyer's approved sample. Defective goods will be replaced at the
supplier's cost.
6. Disputes. Any dispute will first be settled by discussion; failing that, through arbitration in Dhaka.
For Padma Textile Mills Ltd
Authorised signatory (fictional sample document)
